title: Fix rejected drain PR #161 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-76)
description:
Drain PR #161 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-76`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-76 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-76`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-76` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- [major] Scope creep: The PR adds extensive unrelated functionality to four-layer-validate.mjs (layer5AllowlistViolations function) and numerous unrelated test changes throughout tests/adapter-and-model-manager.test.mjs — the task only asked for documentation of allowedExtensions in project.json.template
- [major] Test pollution: The PR adds 18+ unrelated test cases covering cost-tracker, notify.mjs, error signatures, load-config, memory scaling, done checklist, deploy pipeline, humanWellness, and provider key resolution — these are outside the scope of the allowedExtensions documentation task
- [critical] Safety violation: The PR exports a new function layer5AllowlistViolations that appears to be security/validation related but was not part of the requested change and lacks proper review for such functionality
